name: Julia
typeSystem: Dynamic by default, with an optional, rich type system (parametric types, abstract type hierarchies) that a sophisticated type-inference and specialisation pass exploits heavily for performance; multiple dispatch selects a method based on the runtime types of all arguments, not just the first.
runtime: Julia generally specialises methods for the argument types used and JIT-compiles them to native code via LLVM as needed, subject to compiler specialisation heuristics. Compiled code can be cached in package or system images and reused.

runtimes.name: Julia JIT (LLVM)
runtimes.role: Generally specialises methods for argument types and JIT-compiles them to native code as needed, subject to specialisation heuristics.

runtimes.name: PackageCompiler.jl (AOT)
runtimes.role: Creates custom sysimages or distributable applications to reduce JIT warm-up latency.

compilers.name: julia (LLVM-based)
compilers.role: The reference implementation; specialises and JIT-compiles methods to native code as needed.

concurrencyModel: Green-thread-like tasks (coroutines) for concurrency, plus true multi-threading (Threads.@threads) and distributed multiprocessing (Distributed.jl) for parallelism across cores and machines.
